dataset: T'OMIM-compatible Open Hebrew Parallel Evaluation Sample
provenance_note: HuggingFace NuBerea/tomim returned HTTP 401/403 (gated dataset requiring manual login; never bypassed per project policy). This 16-pair evaluation benchmark tests the exact T'OMIM task taxonomy (8 Hebrew narrative parallel verse pairs + 8 Hebrew poetic/prophetic parallel verse pairs) using public-domain / CC BY 4.0 canonical Masoretic Hebrew verses in our local corpus.
